messages:
mia: FYI Acme (Enterprise) just escalated — intermittent 500s on /v1/generate hitting their dedicated pool after yesterday's routing config push. Sales says customer is blocked on onboarding. Can we triage and decide hotfix vs next release? @devin @sam

devin: Looking at logs now. Early signal: routing-rule produced an empty model tag, fallback to a model variant not deployed to their Dedicated pool. Proxy returns 502 -> app translates to 500s.

sam: I see nginx upstream read timeouts ~22:14 UTC and a simultaneous spike in KV cache misses. Feels like routing + cache inconsistency.

anita (eng-sre): If it's purely config routing, rollback is low-risk. We can rollback to previous routing-rule in ~30m, canary at 5% for 20m, then ramp. Full rollback + verification ~2h.

kevin: Sales says Acme will pause onboarding until resolved. SLA indicates P1 for enterprise production impact. My recommendation: hotfix (rollback) + comms now, then postmortem and permanent fix in backlog.

mia: Proposed plan: 1) anita lead rollback, 2) canary 5% x20m, 3) sam to validate 200 OKs + latency check, 4) if green ramp to 100%, 5) kevin notify account + #incidents. Approve?

sam: +1. Quick Q: any schema/db changes or infra deploys in that window? I don't see any DB migrations on the timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy 1845a3 rolled back to config: routing-rule-2026 (initiated by anita) — started 2024-11-12T22:45:12Z

anita: Rollback started. Canary 5% is live. Watching metrics: requests, error rate, KV hit-rate. Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd123/infra?panelId=2

sam: Canary metrics look good, errors down to baseline and KV hit-rate improving.

anita: Ramping to 100% now.

deploy-bot: routing-rule-2026 promoted to 100% (completed 2024-11-12T22:58:03Z). No elevated errors in the last 10m.

kevin: Sending Acme update now: "We've identified the routing config mismatch causing fallback to an undeployed model; we rolled back to the prior config and are monitoring. Traffic and error rates have normalized. Engineering will follow up with root-cause and a permanent fix timeline." @mia can you paste that into the account thread and sales convo?

mia: Pasted to the Acme account thread and pinged sales: "Short: routing config mismatch caused fallback to undeployed model; rolled back; monitoring is good. Next: eng to produce postmortem + timeline for permanent fix within 48h. PM will share postmortem and rollout plan." :thumbsup:

devin: I'll gather logs, add reproducer steps, and open a trunk issue for config validation to prevent empty-tag pushes. Tagging for an RFC on config schema validation.

mia: Thanks all. Postmortem owner assigned to devin. I'll open backlog ticket for config validation and add to next sprint planning. Closing this triage thread.
